user_problem: Teams have approved messages and existing assets but cannot see which messages each asset can support without inventing new proof.
unique_output: A message-to-asset reuse matrix with exact supplied locations, allowed audience/context, unsupported placements and concrete adaptation requests; no new claims, campaign plan or variant validation.
test_case: Map three approved messages to four supplied asset summaries, preserving one audience restriction and one message with no supporting asset.
overlap_to_check: claim-evidence-map tests factual support; this output maps approved message use across assets, not evidence truth or promotion-variant-check.
specific_guardrail: Use supplied evidence and explicit constraints only; missing authority and unknown facts stay unresolved.
